title: Raksha Bandhan
story: A festival of protection, promise, affection, and remembered responsibility between siblings and loved ones.

pack.promise: A free Raksha Bandhan family pack — the story behind the thread, three colouring sheets, a promise card to fill in, and one question to ask at the table.
pack.familyQuestion: Who in this family has quietly protected you — and did you ever thank them for it?
ritual: Read the story of the thread together — three minutes.
Colour a rakhi each, on screen or printed.
Ask the question at dinner, and let the youngest answer first.
pack.shareText: We're doing a free Raksha Bandhan family pack from Khatakshetra — story, colouring and one question to ask at the table.

title: Krishna Janmashtami
story: Krishna's birth is remembered as hope arriving in darkness, joy crossing danger, and love becoming playful wisdom.
coloring: Baby Krishna, butter pot, flute, and dahi handi

pack.promise: A free Janmashtami family pack — Krishna's birth story, a five-question family quiz, three colouring sheets including the dahi handi, and a question worth carrying home.
pack.familyQuestion: Krishna was born in a prison and still brought joy. What is one hard place where your family still found something to celebrate?
ritual: Read how hope arrived at midnight — three minutes.
Play the Krishna quiz together, then colour the dahi handi.
Ask the question before the lamps go out.
pack.shareText: Free Janmashtami family pack from Khatakshetra — Krishna's birth story, a quiz and colouring for the children.

title: Ganesh Chaturthi
story: Ganesha teaches beginnings, boundaries, repair, wisdom, and the courage to start again.
coloring: Ganesha, modak bowl, mouse vahana, and bamboo platform

pack.promise: A free Ganesh Chaturthi family pack — a source-labelled Ganesha story, a quiz, three colouring sheets, and a three-day family challenge.
pack.familyQuestion: Ganesha is asked first to clear the way. What is the one small obstacle your family could remove this week?
ritual: Read why Ganesha is remembered before every beginning.
Colour a Ganesha each, and name the obstacle you want cleared.
Come back on day three and say whether it moved.
